specification.experiment: E3c matched causal evidence: radial depth versus plane residual
specification.shared_evidence: At each actual KF snapshot: source-disjoint, already arrived views; intersection of finite radial-depth and relative-plane scores per view. Both use >=2 views, second-largest score, same plane-zero support veto, relative predicted-radius normalization and identical subgroup calibration. Common mask is applied before aggregation, never from future eligibility.
specification.support_sensitivity: Both D_union and P_union veto if ANY shared view has depth==0 OR plane==0. This tests dependence on the primary plane-defined support veto.
specification.ablation: D_native reproduces original B6 median. D_maskmedian uses the shared view mask, >=2 count and shared plane support veto but median aggregation. Shared gates inherit PCA quality; this is a conditional score comparison, not a PCA-free depth baseline or computational advantage claim.

risk_calibration.selection: office0 cumulative maximum; maximum higher quantile across mandatory groups and each anchor with >=100 finite normals; strict >; unobserved kept

specification.admission: E3b immediate provisional rendering, absorbing rejection, actual snapshot review; no DEFER, no map or pose reoptimization
specification.decision: E3c-specific prospective criterion, not a retroactive E3b pass: on fresh room2 both primary methods must pass risk/coverage/nontrivial rejection constraints, P must improve bad recall on their identical ever-finite cohort by >=2 percentage points with precision loss <=0.1 percentage point. Union sensitivity must have positive P recall gain and both pass safety. Regressions can falsify portability. Failure keeps E4 on hold; report score benefit as unsupported, not a hole-repair failure.
specification.scope: office0 development; room0 and room1 previously inspected regressions; room2 is a single fresh scene selected before E3c extraction or GT inspection; no multi-scene generalization claim
